MINUTES
  REGULAR PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION
  February 21, 2017

A regular meeting of the Park and Activities Commission of the City of Rolling Hills
Estates was called to order at 7:00 p.m. in the City Hall Council Chambers, 4045 Palos
Verdes Drive North, Rolling Hills Estates, California, by CHAIR PORTUGAL.

COMMISSIONERS PRESENT: Persichina, Pope, Portugal, Retz, and Romanelli

COMMISSIONERS ABSENT:  Giglia

STAFF PRESENT:  Andy Clark, Community Services Director
  Daniel A-Haja, Senior Recreation Leader

PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION DRAFT MINUTES, JANUARY 17, 2017

COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER RETZ

  TO APPROVE THE DRAFT MEETING MINUTES OF JANUARY 17, 2017 AS
  WRITTEN.

THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIR PORTUGAL SO ORDERED.

AUDIENCE ITEMS/WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS NOT ON THE AGENDA

None.

THE COMMISSION THANKED CHAIR PORTUGAL FOR HER SERVICE AND
COMMISSIONER POPE ASSUMED HER APPOINTMENT OF PARKS AND
ACTIVITIES CHAIR.

CONSENT CALENDAR

None.

BUSINESS ITEMS

A.  GEORGE F CANYON NATURE CENTER ANNUAL REPORT

Andrea Vona, Executive Director, PVP Land Conservancy, summarized the George F
Canyon Nature Center 2016 Annual Report. Ms. Vona also thanked the PV Library for
their participation with story time program and stated that several people have gone
through training to become a docent at the Nature Center.

THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIR POPE MOVED TO RECEIVE AND FILE THIS
ITEM.

B.  RECOGNITION OF ERNIE HOWLETT PARK MURAL (Presentation by
  Marianna DeSalles, Art Instructor)

Marianna DeSalles, Art Instructor, proposed an unveiling event for the students who
helped with the mural.

In response to a question from CHAIR POPE, Ms. DeSalles stated that there were
approximately fifteen students who helped with the mural as well as family and friends.

COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI asked about the possibility to combine the event with
the Breakfast Ride event.

COMMISSIONER PERSICHINA inquired if the Pepper Tree foundation can fund the
event. Community Services Director Clark responded yes and stated that the
Commission’s park tours begin approximately May 15 and the event could be in
conjunction with this meeting date.

 Regular Park & Activities Commission Minutes
  1
 February 21, 2017
 COMMISSIONER RETZ moved, seconded by CHAIR PORTUGAL to,

  ACCEPT THE PROPOSAL TO HOLD A RECOGNITION EVENT ON MAY 15,
  2017.

THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIR POPE SO ORDERED.

C.  PALOS VERDES DRIVE MEDIANS LANDSCAPE PROJECT PROPOSAL

Community Services Director stated that staff recommends that the Park and Activities
Commission determine if the project of landscaping the Palos Verdes Drive medians
should go forward.

COMMISSIONER RETZ stated that he really likes the way the plants look now and
asked about how the plants will change as they mature.

Sean Bennett, Bennett Landscaping responded that they will grow to 24-30 inches and
described the different plants.

In response to a question by COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI, Mr. Bennett stated that
the plants will take approximately four to five months to fully mature.

COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI asked if there are any issues with waiting another month
before taking this item to Council. Mr. Bennett stated that they are trying to take
advantage of the weather since it is better for the ground to be moist.

COMMISSIONER PERSICHINA moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER PORTUGAL to,

  RECOMMEND THAT CITY COUNCIL CONTRACT BENNETT LANDSCAPE TO
  LANDSCAPE THE REMAINING NEW MEDIANS ON THE WEST SIDE LOCATED
  ON PALOS VERDES DRIVE NORTH AND LOWER SILVER SPUR ROAD
  UTILIZING THE “MODEL MEDIAN” LANDSCAPE  DESIGN  AS  THE
  TEMPLATE.

  AYES:  Persichina, Portugal, Chair Pope, Retz, and Romanelli
  NOES:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
  RECUSE:  None
  ABSENT:  Giglia

CHAIR POPE REPORTED THAT THE MOTION CARRIED.

D.  PROPOSED PRIVATE COACHING SPORTS FIELD PERMIT REQUIREMENT

Community Services Director Clark provided an overview on a proposal for private
coaching sports field permit requirements.

COMMISSION PERSICHINA stated that parents are willing to pay quite a bit for private
coaching and stated that there is no business where you do not pay for the facility you
are using to conduct business.

COMMISSIONER RETZ stated that there should also be a background check
requirement for coaches.

Community Services Director Clark also stated that there have also been fitness training
at the parks and other cities are now charging a permit fee.

COMMISSIONER PERSICHINA stated that insurance should also be required.

Community Services Director Clark stated that staff recommends that a subcommittee
be appointed.

 Regular Park & Activities Commission Minutes
  2
 February 21, 2017
 COMMISSIONER RETZ moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER PERSICHINA to,

  CREATE A PRIVATE COACHING AND TRAINING FEES SUBCOMMITTEE TO
  ASSIST STAFF IN REVIEWING AND DEVLEOPING RECOMMENDATIONS
  TO ADDRESS THESE ISSUES, WHO WILL INCLUDE COMMISSIONER’S
  PERISCHINA, RETZ, AND ROMANELLI.

There being no objection, CHAIR POPE so ordered.

E.  SPECIAL EVENT PROPOSAL (Memorandum from Senior Recreation Leader)

Daniel A-Haja, Senior Recreation Leader, presented a proposal for a new special event
to offer a movie night in Ernie Howlett Park.

Senior Recreation Leader A-Haja stated that staff recommends that the Park and
Activities Commission makes a recommendation to City Council to approve the addition
of a Movie night to the City’s summer special event offerings for Fiscal Year 2017-2018.

COMMISSIONER PORTUGAL asked if the proposal was to hold the event once this
year with the hopes of holding the event three times next year. Senior Recreation Leader
A-Haja responded yes and stated that the main target will be young families.

Community Services Director Clark stated that the movies will start at approximately
8:45 p.m. when it begins to get dark.

CHAIR POPE asked how it will be funded. Community Services Director Clark stated
that the hope is to get sponsors for the event.

COMMISSIONER RETZ moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER PORTUGAL to,
  TO RECOMMEND THAT CITY COUNCIL APPROVE THE ADDITION OF A
  MOVIE NIGHT TO THE CITY’S SPECIAL EVENT OFFERINGS FOR FY 2017-
  2018.

THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIR POPE SO ORDERED.

  AYES:  Persichina, Portugal, Chair Pope, Retz, and Romanelli
  NOES:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
  RECUSE:  None
  ABSENT:  Giglia

CHAIR POPE REPORTED THAT THE MOTION CARRIED.

ADJOURN TO THE PEPPER TREE FOUNDATION ADVISORY BOARD MEETING

COMMISSIONER PORTUGAL moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER RETZ to,

  ADJOURN TO THE PEPPER TREE FOUNDATION ADVISORY BOARD
  MEETING.

THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIR POPE SO ORDERED.

A.  THE HILLS ARE ALIVE RACE CONSULTANT AGREEMENT

Community Services Director Clark provided an overview of this item and stated that staff
recommends that the Pepper Tree Foundation Advisory Board make a recommendation
to the Pepper Tree Foundation Board of Directors to approved the agreement with
Michael Hogue Productions to provide fundraising, promotional and consulting services
for the 2017 Hills Are Alice Race.

COMMISSIONER RETZ indicated that the insurance requirements as stated in the
agreement seems insufficient.

 Regular Park & Activities Commission Minutes
  3
 February 21, 2017
 Community Services Director Clark stated that he will have the City Attorney and the
CJPIA, review the insurance requirement.

THE COMMISSION AGREED TO TABLE THIS ITEM TO THE NEXT PLANNING
COMMISSION MEETING OF MARCH 20, 2017.

 B.  PROPOSED PEPPER  TREE  FOUNDATION  GOLF  TOURNAMENT
  FUNDRAISING EVENT

Community Services Director Clark gave a brief report that Mayor Zerunyan would like to
propose a Golf Tournament Fundraising event for the Pepper Tree Foundation. Mayor
Zerunyan would like to make this proposal to the Rolling Hills Country Club and this will
also be a shared event with the USC Golf Team.

THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIR POPE MOVED TO RECEIVE AND FILE THIS
ITEM.

RECONVENE TO THE PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING

COMMISSIONER PERSICHINA moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI
  to,

  RECONVENE TO THE PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING

THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIR POPE SO ORDERED.

COMMISSION ITEMS (VERBAL REPORT)

A.  ADOPT-A-PARK REPORTS – Community Services Director stated that the City’s
fencing contractor will be coming back this week to repair fences.

COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI asked why half of the fence at Rockbluff Park is vinyl
and half wood. Community Services Director Clark stated that they likely ran out of
material.

COMMISSIONER RETZ stated that the trail at the end of Dapplegray has a 6” pool of
water.

COMMISSIONER PERSICHINA asked about the sandbags at Howlett Park. Community
Services Director Clark stated that 5,000 sand bags were given out and more had to be
ordered.

In response to a question from CHAIR POPE, Community Services Director Clark stated
that identification is now being checked for address verification before issuing sand bags.

B.  CITY CELEBRATION SUBCOMMITTEE MEETING UPDATE - COMMISSIONER
RETZ AND CHAIR POPE provided highlights on the meeting. Community Services
Director Clark stated that the turnout of this event will determine how often this event will
be held.

THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIR POPE MOVED TO RECEIVE AND FILE THIS
ITEM.

DIRECTOR’S ITEMS (VERBAL REPORT)

A.  SOUTH BAY COUNCIL OF GOVERNMENTS GENERAL ASSEMBLY-
FEBRUARY 24, 2016 – Community Services Director Clark provided information on this
item.

B.  PARADE SUBCOMMITTE DEBRIEFING MEETING-FEBRUARY 28, 2017 –
Community Services Director Clark stated that the packet for this meeting will be sent out
on Thursday.

 Regular Park & Activities Commission Minutes
  4
 February 21, 2017
 C.  EQUESTRIAN STRUCTURES BID RESULTS – Community Services Director
Clark stated that there is approximately $70K for this project and City Council will approve
the replacement of the two judge’s booth structures.

D.  ANNUAL 700 FORM SUBMITTAL – Community Services Director stated that we
will provide the forms to Commissioner’s.

Community Services Director reported that the Lyon’s Club is interested in helping the
City with volunteer opportunities and grants of up to $10K.

COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI asked about the play equipment. Community Services
Director stated that the installation of the play equipment has been delayed due to the
rain. CHAIR POPE asked about trees in the City’s parks. Community Services Director
Clark stated that the trees are pretty deep-rooted but this is something to keep in mind.

THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIR POPE MOVED TO RECEIVE AND FILE THIS
ITEM.

MATTERS OF INFORMATION

A.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS OF JANUARY 24, 2017

B.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS OF FEBRUARY 14, 2017

C.  PLANNING COMMISSION DRAFT MINUTES OF FEBRUARY 6, 2017

THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIR POPE MOVED TO RECEIVE AND FILE ALL
THE ITEMS.

FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS

Community Services Director Clark state that The Hills are Alice Race Consultant
Agreement will be a future agenda item.

COMMISSIONER RETZ asked about construction on the reservoir. Community Services
Director stated that he will find out and e-mail the Commissioner’s with the information.

COMMISSIONER PERSICHENA asked about the sign for Casaba Homes and asked if
they received approval. Community Services Director Clark replied that he was not aware
of the sign being reinstalled and would notify the Planning Director.

ADJOURNMENT

COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER RETZ to,

  ADJOURN THE PARKS AND ACTIVITIES MEETING

THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIR POPE adjourned the meeting at 7:56 p.m. to
the next Parks & Activities Commission Meeting of March 20, 2017.

Respectfully submitted,  Approved,

__________________________  _________________________
Carol Corea  Douglas R. Prichard
Minutes Secretary  City Clerk

 Regular Park & Activities Commission Minutes
  5
 February 21, 2017
